probe_contract.description: Copy-only finite staged-LDGSTS operand stream. A 128-thread CTA moves private 16-KiB two-byte-element operand panels through a complete-pair ring with LDGSTS.E.BYPASS.128 / LDGDEPBAR / DEPBAR, replicating the launch geometry and ring structure of the sm80 128-thread K64 staged GEMM source class without any matrix instruction, output epilogue, production shape, or production duration. Rounds 0 gives the same-grid empty launch plus ring prologue; the 256-to-512 steady-round secant gives the per-tier steady service; the finite residual follows the methodology of the accepted A800 staged_ldgsts_depth3_wave_scaling_sm80 reference.

derived_model.finite_residual_definition: median duration at 32 rounds minus the same-grid zero-round launch and the 256-to-512 steady-round secant
derived_model.selection_rule: The staged GEMM operand stream is intrinsically mixed-tier: the shared A panel is L2-resident while each CTA's B panel strip is DRAM-unique. The parameter is the finite residual at one full launch-local cohort (132 CTAs = one resident CTA on each of 132 H200 SMs), the midpoint mixed tier (50 pct L2), and the canonical three-complete-slot ring, with per-cell medians pooled over two independent clock-accepted capture processes.
derived_model.boundedness: Same-cell (50 pct L2, three slots) residuals on H200: grid 64: -1964.0 ns, grid 96: -1038.0 ns, grid 132: 394.0 ns, grid 264: 1538.0 ns, grid 371: 1076.0 ns; five-slot ring: grid 132: -440.0 ns, grid 264: -1016.0 ns; pure-DRAM (0 pct L2) three-slot residuals: grid 64: -2666.0 ns, grid 96: -320.0 ns, grid 132: -56.0 ns, grid 264: -998.0 ns, grid 371: -2490.0 ns.
derived_model.formula: prediction = common_terms + one_wave_mixed_tier_startup_ns, once per launch

allowed_use: One launch-local additive startup for a staged K64-tile 128-thread two-byte-element GEMM source program whose operand read stream carries both L2-hit and DRAM-miss bytes, composed once per launch. The probe is byte-level, so the two-byte scope covers fp16 and bf16 element encodings of the same panel geometry.
forbidden_use: A production GEMM duration, a per-shape or per-bucket correction, a generic DRAM or L2 capacity replacement, a per-grid or per-wave latency lookup, or a second serial charge of work already inside the common K-tile pipeline. Pure-DRAM operand streams are outside scope.

clock_gate.rule: every probe process runs under nvidia-smi -lms 50; a process is accepted only if it shows a busy sample and every busy sample is >= 1980 MHz, otherwise it is rejected and re-run
